summary: Apartment: removal for nonpayment, abandoned-property clause without the legend, repair interruption, force majeure.

findings.quote: If rent is more than five days late, Owner may enter the Dwelling and remove Residents' personal property to a storage facility until all past-due rent is paid.
After Residents move out, Owner is not responsible for storing or disposing of any personal property Residents leave in the Dwelling.
Owner may temporarily interrupt water or electricity to the Dwelling when necessary to make repairs to the building.
Owner is excused from further performance of its obligations under this Lease Contract for the duration of the event.

outOfScope.quote: A late fee of 10% of the monthly rent applies.

nearMisses.quote: Owner may enter the Dwelling for repairs between 8:00 a.m. and 7:30 p.m. after giving at least 24 hours' notice.
